responsibility: This autogenerated companion file attaches GCC manual URL metadata to options declared in gcc/config/m68k/ieee.opt. In the option-processing/documentation subsystem for the m68k target, .opt.urls files provide UrlSuffix entries that let generated option tables and diagnostics link a switch to its manual section; here it records that the legacy -mieee-fp option currently has no matching published URL. It carries documentation-link annotations only and does not affect target parsing or code generation behavior.
